answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a slashable escrow: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated evidence triggers a penalty proportional to k², so splitting stake cannot dilute exposure. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss compounds the swarm’s losses, and asymmetric depreciation makes recovery costly. Whether dawn breaks over karst or a harbor, coordination leaves an expensive, measurable footprint.
